definition: The rate at which work is done or energy is transferred, $P = \frac{\Delta W}{\Delta t}$, which for a force $F$ moving a body at velocity $v$ along its line is $P = Fv$; its unit is the watt, where $1\ \text{W} = 1\ \text{J s}^{-1}$.

The ratio of the useful energy (or power) output of a device to the total energy (or power) input, $\eta$; it has no unit and is always less than 1 for a real machine, because some input energy is dissipated.
The energy released per unit volume of a fuel, in $\text{J m}^{-3}$; it differs from specific energy, the energy released per unit mass in $\text{J kg}^{-1}$, by a factor of the fuel's density.
